strategy: Real Game simulation, full-power geometric aim, initial power/kinetic/idle then cheapest eligible research; zero-kill frontier runs trigger two earlier-region farming runs. Each boss must die to physical contact with the remaining launch budget. No free money, granted research or forced boss summons.

notes: New region entry metrics use naturally earned research and full-power manual-mode pilot shots. They do not grant an entry build or buffs.
Bare attack / inner HP is only an opening indicator: split balls, temporary drops and combination technologies explain later-stage harvesting.
Boss challenge length counts all runs from first encounter to first victory, including runs that fail to summon it again. It is not simply the number of visible fights.
Combat time excludes aiming, upgrades, menu reading and idle delay. Automated routes establish reachability and measurable pacing, not subjective enjoyment.
Prices, rewards, drop rates, ring curves, and boss contact multipliers were not adjusted. Existing generated maps retain stored HP.
